meta.title: Optimize client and server performance
meta.body_summary: Add a comprehensive optimization plan document and implement code-level performance enhancements (async processing, caching, metrics) for the GB28181 SIP proxy.

perf_labels.notes: Large code addition with no review, no performance evidence; merged quickly by maintainer, indicating a low-friction self‑merge environment.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2236 changed lines across 11 files, this is a large change by absolute volume. It adds new concurrent processing, caching, and monitoring modules. Despite the lack of performance evidence or review, it was merged quickly, suggesting a self‑maintained project with minimal gatekeeping on perf PRs.

review_details.performance_claim: The PR claims to improve performance through async processing, caching, thread pool tuning, and monitoring, but only via a markdown document and code additions; no measurable claim.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A large optimization PR with no review or performance evidence was merged quickly by the maintainer. This illustrates a process boundary where Agent contributions can be accepted without any validation of performance claims, typical of a low‑barrier or self‑maintained project.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics provided; only a narrative optimization document and code changes without any runtime performance data.

core_change_summary.description: Added a comprehensive optimization Markdown document and implemented Java code changes: custom thread pool configuration, async SIP message processor, Caffeine‑based caching service, metrics endpoints, and a configuration properties class. Also added a YAML configuration example and updated Maven dependencies.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Markdown document and YAML config serve as documentation; POM files were updated for new dependencies (Caffeine).
change_trajectory: First commit: added initial markdown optimization plan (537 lines).
Second commit: added async processor, caching service, metrics, properties, and updated thread pool configuration; also modified existing SipProcessorObserver.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with markdown plan and code changes by Cursor agent.
No review or comment by any party.
Maintainer merged within ~1.2 hours without any interaction.
